how: Snow & Surf in Kwai Chung offers indoor ski and snowboard machines with coaches; no real-snow slope exists locally.
Ski Tech in Wong Chuk Hang runs sensor-equipped ski and snowboard simulator lessons, and Slope8 in North Point has revolving-carpet slopes.
Watch collector clubs such as Watch Ho & Co and The Horology Club hold regular gatherings in Hong Kong.
HKU SPACE's cheese appreciation certificate includes a hands-on cheesemaking workshop.
A native Tamil tutor in Tung Chung offers private and group lessons, and a Hong Kong group has run a 15-hour Tamil introductory course.
A Hong Kong Island tutor lists in-person and online Indian classical lessons that include tabla rhythms; no dedicated tabla school was found.
Pagar Nusa silat practitioners train and mentor Indonesian community members in Hong Kong, and a pencak silat federation is being explored.
The Hong Kong, China Mountaineering and Climbing Union runs climbing courses and certifies hill-walking leaders; no alpine terrain exists locally.
